f0 rebuilds the shipped k_mla_fwd (1d95fa84 = a08-1 E2 4d63d400 minus 3 redundant s_wait_xcnt) byte for byte; every later rung is a patch in fwd2_patches/ (paths gfx1250_mla/...) and/or generator args.

Baseline flydsl: the FlyDSL MLA forward of the Primus-Turbo checkout in HKL_TURBO_DIR -- run this ladder with HKL_TURBO_DIR=/home/lihuzhan/projects/2026_1023__v2/Primus-Turbo-hk-fwd (FlyDSL 917e240b kernel + 7d8d69a3 host counters).

Numerics (user decision 2026-10-30): rungs need not stay bitwise equal to FlyDSL; the gate is SNR of o / lse not below flydsl's by more than 0.1 dB, determinism, finite outputs. bitwise_with marks the rungs that still are.
